title: Healthy Villager
description: Healing villager when they fully sleep, weaker version of bedrock
body:
You really like villager heal when it sleep in bedrock and want it to be in java edition? Take this
# Healthy-Villager
A nerfed version of bedrock edition healing

Healing villager a small amount when they wake up
## Notes
Configurable using command `/function Healthy_Villager:heal with {"strength":<amplifier>,"duration":<seconds>}`
Villager will be healed if they wake up at dawn, the datapack checks once in 0-400 tick and apply 5 second of regeneration 2
## Performance
it will create a small lag when it checks if you have a potatoes device
## How to install:
Drag the zip files into datapacks gui when creating world or navigate to <your world name>/world/datapacks and put there, then go to your world/server and use `/datapack enable "Healthy_Villager-datapack-1.21+.zip"`
